reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question by proposing a clear, physically sound mechanism (configurational entropy preserving a homogeneous single-phase structure to enhance electron–phonon coupling) with a specific, testable intervention and falsification criterion, and it is well-grounded in cited evidence on HEA superconductivity.
